  <style>
    /* ── Reset ── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    /* ── Tokens ── */
    :root {
      --blue:        #2563eb;
      --blue-dark:   #1d4ed8;
      --blue-light:  #3b82f6;
      --cyan:        #06b6d4;
      --green:       #10b981;
      --text:        #0f172a;
      --text-2:      #334155;
      --muted:       #64748b;
      --muted-light: #94a3b8;
      --bg:          #f8fafc;
      --card:        #ffffff;
      --border:      #e2e8f0;
      --border-2:    #cbd5e1;
      --navy:        #0f172a;
      --navy-2:      #1e293b;
      --radius-sm:   6px;
      --radius:      12px;
      --radius-lg:   18px;
      --shadow-sm:   0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
      --shadow:      0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.10), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
      --shadow-lg:   0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.14), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
      --max-content: 740px;
      --max-wide:    1100px;
    }

    /* ── Base ── */
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.7;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    a { color: var(--blue); text-decoration: none; }
    a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

    /* ── Header ── */
    .site-header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .header-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-wide);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 1.5rem;
      height: 64px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
    }
    .site-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      text-decoration: none !important;
      margin-right: auto;
    }
    .logo-img {
      height: 36px;
      width: auto;
      display: block;
    }
    .header-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.25rem;
    }
    .header-nav a {
      padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-2);
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
      text-decoration: none !important;
    }
    .header-nav a:hover { background: var(--border); color: var(--text); }
    .nav-cta {
      padding: 0.4rem 0.95rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--blue);
      color: #fff !important;
      white-space: nowrap;
      text-decoration: none !important;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }
    .nav-cta:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); }

    /* Mobile: logo + CTA on top row, nav links centered on a second row */
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .header-inner {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        height: auto;
        padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
        row-gap: 0.5rem;
      }
      .header-nav {
        order: 3;
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 0.15rem;
      }
      .header-nav a { padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem; font-size: 0.8rem; }
      .logo-img { height: 30px; }
    }

    /* ── Main ── */
    main { min-height: calc(100vh - 64px - 200px); }

    /* ── Footer ── */
    .site-footer {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: #94a3b8;
      margin-top: 5rem;
    }
    .footer-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-wide);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 3rem 1.5rem 2rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 2rem;
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; }
    }
    .footer-brand .logo { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
    .footer-brand .logo span { color: var(--blue-light); }
    .footer-brand p { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.6; }
    .footer-col h4 { color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
    .footer-col a { display: block; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.2rem 0; text-decoration: none !important; transition: color 0.15s; }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: #fff; }
    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid #1e293b;
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
      max-width: var(--max-wide);
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    .footer-disclaimer { color: #64748b; font-size: 0.78rem; margin-top: 0.25rem; }

    /* ── CTA Box ── */
    .cta-box {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eff6ff 0%, #e0f2fe 100%);
      border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 1.75rem;
      margin: 2.5rem 0;
    }
    .cta-box h3 {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }
    .cta-box p { color: var(--text-2); font-size: 0.92rem; }
    .cta-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
      background: var(--blue);
      color: #fff !important;
      padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      margin-top: 0.9rem;
      text-decoration: none !important;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(37,99,235,0.3);
    }
    .cta-btn:hover {
      background: var(--blue-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(37,99,235,0.35);
    }
    .cta-btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--blue) !important;
      border: 2px solid var(--blue);
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    .cta-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--blue); color: #fff !important; }
    .tg-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.3rem;
      background: #229ED9;
      color: #fff !important;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      text-decoration: none !important;
      vertical-align: middle;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tg-btn svg { flex-shrink: 0; }
    .tg-btn:hover { background: #1a8bbf; }

    /* ── Badges / Tags ── */
    .tag {
      display: inline-block;
      background: #eff6ff;
      color: #1d4ed8;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
      text-transform: capitalize;
    }

    /* ── Category chips (dark backgrounds) ── */
    .cat-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; justify-content: center; }
    .cat-chip {
      padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      color: #cbd5e1 !important; text-decoration: none !important; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    }
    .cat-chip:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: #fff !important; }
    .cat-chip.active { background: #fff; color: #07091a !important; border-color: #fff; }

    
    /* ── Post layout ── */
    .post-wrap {
      padding: 2rem 1.5rem 4rem;
    }
    .post-container {
      max-width: var(--max-content);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ── Back link ── */
    .back-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      text-decoration: none !important;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      transition: color 0.15s;
    }
    .back-link:hover { color: var(--blue); }
    .back-link svg { flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* ── Post header ── */
    .post-header { margin-bottom: 1.75rem; }
    .post-tags { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .post-header h1 {
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4.5vw, 2.1rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.25;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    /* ── Byline ── */
    .post-byline { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }
    .byline-avatar {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue), var(--cyan));
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .byline-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text); }
    .byline-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); }

    /* ── Featured image ── */
    .post-hero-img {
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }
    .post-hero-img img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 400px;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center center;
      display: block;
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) { .post-hero-img img { height: 220px; } }

    /* ── Post content typography ── */
    .post-content { line-height: 1.85; }
    .post-content h2 {
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin: 2.5rem 0 0.75rem;
      padding-top: 0.5rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .post-content h3 {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 1.75rem 0 0.6rem;
    }
    .post-content p {
      margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--text-2);
      font-size: 1rem;
    }
    .post-content ul {
      margin: 0.75rem 0 1.25rem 0;
      padding-left: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }
    .post-content li {
      position: relative;
      padding-left: 1.4rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--text-2);
    }
    .post-content li::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0.65em;
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--blue);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .post-content strong { color: var(--text); font-weight: 700; }
    .post-content em { color: var(--text-2); }
    .post-content a { color: var(--blue); font-weight: 500; }
    .post-content a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    .post-content pre {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: #e2e8f0;
      padding: 1.25rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow-x: auto;
      margin: 1.5rem 0;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .post-content code {
      background: #eff6ff;
      color: #1d4ed8;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 0.875em;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .post-content pre code { background: none; color: inherit; padding: 0; font-weight: 400; }

    /* ── Mid CTA trading widget ── */
    .cta-trading {
      display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; align-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0f1e 0%, #0f2044 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.3);
      border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.75rem;
      margin: 2.5rem 0; overflow: hidden; position: relative;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    }
    .cta-trading::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: -60px; right: 160px;
      width: 300px; height: 300px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(37,99,235,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .cta-trading-left { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .cta-trading-solo .cta-trading-left { max-width: 640px; }
    .cta-trading-badge {
      display: inline-block; background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15);
      color: #10b981; border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3);
      font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 0.2rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .cta-trading h3 { color: #fff; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .cta-trading p { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .cta-features { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
    .cta-features li { font-size: 0.8rem; color: #cbd5e1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; }
    .feat-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .feat-dot.green { background: #10b981; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #10b981; }
    .feat-dot.blue { background: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #3b82f6; }
    .feat-dot.cyan { background: #06b6d4; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #06b6d4; }
    .feat-dot.purple { background: #8b5cf6; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #8b5cf6; }
    .cta-btn-glow { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(37,99,235,0.5), 0 4px 20px rgba(37,99,235,0.35) !important; }
    .cta-btn-glow:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(59,130,246,0.7), 0 8px 28px rgba(37,99,235,0.5) !important; transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .cta-trading-right { flex-shrink: 0; width: 200px; }
    @media (max-width: 600px) { .cta-trading-right { display: none; } }
    .mock-screen {
      background: #0d1117; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; font-size: 0.7rem;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    }
    .mock-header {
      background: #161b22; padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    }
    .mock-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; }
    .mock-dot.red { background: #ef4444; }
    .mock-dot.yellow { background: #f59e0b; }
    .mock-dot.green { background: #10b981; box-shadow: none; }
    .mock-title { color: #475569; font-size: 0.6rem; margin-left: 0.3rem; }
    .mock-body { padding: 0.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; }
    .mock-signal {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 0.65rem;
    }
    .mock-signal.buy { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.2); }
    .mock-signal.sell { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.2); }
    .sig-dir { font-weight: 700; }
    .mock-signal.buy .sig-dir { color: #10b981; }
    .mock-signal.sell .sig-dir { color: #ef4444; }
    .sig-pair { color: #94a3b8; }
    .sig-conf { color: #60a5fa; font-weight: 600; }
    .mock-chart { padding: 0.3rem 0; }
    .mock-chart svg { width: 100%; height: 36px; }
    .mock-stat { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.15rem 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
    .mock-stat span { color: #64748b; font-size: 0.62rem; }
    .stat-val { font-weight: 700; }
    .stat-val.green { color: #10b981; }

    /* ── CTA badge ── */
    .cta-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      background: var(--blue);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    }

    /* ── Deriv ad banner ── */
    .deriv-ad-banner {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      background: linear-gradient(100deg, #0d0d0d 0%, #1a0a0a 40%, #1a0505 70%, #0d0d0d 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.2rem 1.75rem;
      margin-top: 2.5rem; text-decoration: none !important;
      transition: opacity 0.2s; overflow: hidden; position: relative;
      min-height: 90px;
    }
    .deriv-ad-banner::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 50%, rgba(255,40,40,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .deriv-ad-banner:hover { opacity: 0.92; }
    .deriv-ad-left { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; flex: 1; }
    .deriv-ad-brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.05rem; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; }
    .deriv-ad-partner { font-size: 0.6rem; color: #6b7280; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
    .deriv-ad-logo {
      font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 900; color: #ff444f;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-style: italic; line-height: 1;
    }
    .deriv-ad-headline {
      font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff;
      line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .deriv-ad-sub { font-size: 0.72rem; color: #9ca3af; }
    .deriv-ad-center { flex-shrink: 0; padding: 0 2rem; }
    .deriv-ad-cta {
      background: #ff444f; color: #fff;
      padding: 0.65rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.95rem; white-space: nowrap;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,68,79,0.45);
      transition: transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.15s;
    }

<p>Navigating the dynamic world of Deriv trading can be complex, but with the right <strong>deriv trading tools</strong>, automation can significantly simplify your journey. Among its standout offerings are the sophisticated Auto Trader Bot and the innovative Digit Trader Bot, each providing a unique approach to automated trading on Deriv. But which of these advanced <strong>deriv bots</strong> is the ideal choice for your trading style and market focus? Let's dive in.</p>
<h3>Auto Trader Bot: Comprehensive Market Automation</h3>
<p>The Nextrader Auto Trader Bot is your go-to solution for automating traditional Rise/Fall and Higher/Lower contracts across a vast array of markets. This includes popular Volatility Indices (V10, V25, V50, V75, V100 + 1Hz), Forex pairs, Gold, Silver, and Crypto. This intelligent bot leverages Nextrader's real-time, non-repaint trading signals, which are meticulously generated only on closed candles after a minimum of 3-4 indicators agree. You can choose from 11 named AI strategies, such as Trend Hunter (EMA crossover), Reversal Radar (RSI), or Swift Scalper (Stochastic RSI), available across 5min, 10min, 30min, and 1-hour timeframes. Beyond signal execution, the Auto Trader Bot incorporates advanced money management systems: Fixed Stake for consistent sizing, Martingale for aggressive recovery, and Mesa Milano for smart, adaptive loss recovery, ensuring your capital is managed systematically with confidence levels ranging from 30-85%.</p>
<h3>Digit Trader Bot: Precision in Last-Digit Prediction</h3>
<p>In contrast, the Nextrader Digit Trader Bot offers a specialized, high-frequency approach, focusing exclusively on predicting the last digit of Deriv contracts. This bot excels in digit-based contracts like DIGITEVEN/ODD/OVER/UNDER/MATCH/DIFF. Its core strength lies in its AI-powered pattern recognition, boasting 95%+ accuracy, achieved by meticulously tracking 50-500 digit history, detecting streaks, and analyzing digit frequency charts. If your strategy revolves around the intricate dance of single digits and you seek a dedicated, analytical edge for this niche, this <strong>binary bot</strong> provides an unparalleled solution.</p>
<h3>Making Your Choice: Which Deriv Bot Suits You?</h3>
<p>So, how do you choose between these two powerful <strong>deriv trading tools</strong>? The Auto Trader Bot is ideal for traders who prefer a broader market approach, relying on comprehensive technical analysis and multi-indicator confirmation. It’s perfect for those who want to automate strategies like scalping or trend following, leveraging Nextrader's robust signal generation across multiple timeframes.</p>
